title: Unresponsive crew member
reference: NASA Basic Life Support (BLS) & ISS Crew Medical Officer Unresponsive Patient Checklist (NASA-STD-3001).

q1.text: Check chest rise, airflow, and carotid pulse for 10 seconds. Is the crew member breathing and do they have a palpable pulse?

i_cpr.text: CARDIOPULMONARY RESUSCITATION (CODE): Secure patient to Crew Medical Restraint System (CMRS). Attach Defibrillator/AED pads. Deliver 100–120 compressions/min using overhead handholds. Insert i-gel airway.

t_cpr.text: Perform 2 minutes of continuous CPR, then pause 5 seconds for automated AED rhythm analysis and shock advisory.

q2.text: Tap both shoulders firmly and shout loudly. Does the crew member open eyes, vocalize, or follow simple commands?

i_unconscious_breathing.text: UNRESPONSIVE WITH PULSE: Place in stable tethered recovery position to maintain open airway. Administer 100% O2 via mask. Check blood glucose immediately.

t_vitals.text: Assess airway patency, carotid pulse, and SpO2 every 2 minutes while measuring blood glucose cartridge.

q_glucose.text: Is the blood glucose reading < 70 mg/dL (severe acute hypoglycemia)?

i_hypoglycemia.text: HYPOGLYCEMIA COMA: Administer 1 tube of oral glucose gel on buccal mucosa if swallowing reflex present, or initiate IV access with 50% Dextrose (D50W) 25g IV push.

i_neuro_check.text: EVALUATE FOR SEIZURE / SYNCOPE: Check pupillary symmetry, rule out head trauma from microgravity impact, and inspect cabin atmospheric CO2 telemetry.

q3.text: Is the crew member alert and oriented to person, location (spacecraft module), and Zulu time?

i_syncope.text: VASOVAGAL / ORTHOSTATIC SYNCOPE: Astronaut recovered consciousness. Hydrate with 500 mL electrolyte pouch; check blood pressure and ECG rhythm strip.

i_confused.text: POST-ICTAL / ACUTE CONFUSION: Keep crew member closely monitored in quiet quarters. Conduct brief neurological assessment and maintain O2 support.

end_monitor.text: Consciousness fully restored. Crew member stable; conduct full vital signs evaluation and schedule rest.

end_escalate.text: CRITICAL NEUROLOGICAL ESCALATION: Flight Surgeon telemedicine channel active. Continuous vital signs and cardiac rhythm streaming.
